heroHeadline: North Korean Women's Soccer Team Arrives at Incheon — First DPRK Athletic Visit to South Korea in Nearly 8 Years
heroSubtitle: A 39-member Naegohyang Women's FC delegation (27 players, 12 staff) landed at Incheon International Airport on May 17, 2026, on an Air China flight from Beijing, to play in the Women's ACL semi-final against Suwon FC on May 20 — the first North Korean sports team visit to the South since 2018. North Korea separately condemned UK sanctions targeting the Songdowon International Children's Camp near Wonsan, imposed over the facility's alleged role in hosting Ukrainian children during Russia's deportation program, calling the measures an 'intolerable insult' on May 15. Trump-Kim summit speculation remains active with South Korean officials describing preparations as 'almost nonexistent.'
footerNote: Data sourced from US/ROK official reports, KCNA, UN panels, IAEA, and institutional analyses. North Korea does not publish national statistics — economic figures are estimates with wide uncertainty ranges.
